Fields low on a page stay above the keyboard on the phone, and another program on your network can hand ArrowLoop a new job.

## ✨ Added

- **Other programs can add a job with `POST /api/jobs`.** Put a long random token in the new optional `ARROWLOOP_API_TOKEN` variable, in the advanced view of the Unraid template, and enter the same token in the other program, such as CastleCommander. It sends the token in the `X-ArrowLoop-Token` header. The token opens the job list and adding a job, never the settings or the trash, and a wrong token is always refused. A name that's taken gets a 409 and the existing job stays as it is. `before` and `after` are dropped, as with every save from the interface.
- **A job added this way runs on its schedule like any other,** and a mirror deletes at its destination, so keep the token as safe as the password. Without the variable nothing changes. Without a password, the job routes stay open to anyone who reaches the port, as they always were, so set one as well. `docs/installing.md` has an example.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The phone app is built with glob 14 and minimatch 11,** which close two advisories in the build tools. Nothing of them ships in the app.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The keyboard doesn't cover the field you're typing in anymore.** ArrowLoop targets Android 16, so it's drawn edge to edge, and Android stopped shrinking the window for the keyboard. A field near the end of a page, like a new target's password, stayed hidden behind it. Every page now makes room for the keyboard and scrolls the field you tapped into view.
- **Two changes to the settings at the same moment both stick.** Each save reads the file, edits it and writes it back, so two at once could lose one of them. They wait for each other now.
